statusSectionDescription: Semantic search finds a page by what it means, not only by the words it contains. The index is built from the page content.
missingHint: Semantic recall stays off until the index is built once.
disabledDescription: Search still matches keywords, it just does not know synonyms. Start the server with --vectors, --vectors-model-dir and --vectors-library to enable it.
autoCheckboxLabel: Update the index when a page is saved
autoCheckboxDescription: When off, new edits are not indexed automatically. The existing index keeps working and you can rebuild it manually.
rebuildDescription: Build the index once from the current page content.
clearDescription: Delete the index and build it from scratch.
clearConfirmDescription: The current index is deleted and built again. Until it finishes, search answers from the keyword index only.
loadError: Could not load the index status
pageDialog.title: Semantic index
pageDialog.description: How this page is represented in the semantic index. Rebuilding it touches only this page.
pageDialog.hintOff: Semantic search is switched off on this server.
pageDialog.hintStale: The page changed after it was embedded. Rebuild it to bring the index up to date.
pageDialog.hintMissing: This page is not in the index yet.
pageDialog.hintQueued: The page is waiting to be embedded.
pageDialog.hintFailed: Embedding this page failed. Rebuild it to try again.
pageDialog.loadError: Could not load this page's index status
